glossary.role: RX-78GP03 Gundam "Dendrobium" (Stamen MS plus Orchis armed base), flown by Kou in space.
Zeon remnant force led by Aiguille Delaz that carries out Operation Stardust in U.C. 0083.

Commander of the Cima Fleet (ex-Zeon marines); allied with the Delaz Fleet, then betrays it to the Federation; pilots the Gelgoog Marine Commander Type and Gerbera Tetra. Rank: Lieutenant Colonel (中佐).
glossary.personality: Scheming, harsh and venomous, intolerant of failure, yet decisive and fiercely loyal to her own men; embittered by how Zeon used her and her homeland Mahal.

glossary.role: Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.
Anaheim Electronics mobile docking ship where Kou receives GP03.
The former Zeon fortress Solomon, renamed by the Federation; site of the 0083 naval review that Gato attacks.
Earth Federation Vice Admiral (中将), commander of the 3rd Earth Orbital Fleet and head of the Gundam Development Project; reformist forced out during Operation Stardust.
glossary.personality: Reform-minded, determined officer who does everything he can against Operation Stardust despite political opposition.

glossary.role: Gundam Development Project Unit 2, RX-78GP02A Gundam "Physalis", the nuclear-armed Gundam stolen by Gato.
Leader of the Delaz Fleet and mastermind of Operation Stardust; former Zeon colonel loyal to Gihren Zabi. Wiki rank: Lieutenant General (0083).
glossary.personality: Zealous idealist devoted to Spacenoid independence and Gihren's cause; stern but paternal toward Gato; dies shouting "Sieg Zeon".

glossary.role: Main antagonist of 0083; Zeon ace "Nightmare of Solomon", Delaz Fleet pilot who steals Gundam GP02 and later pilots the Neue Ziel. Rank: Major (U.C. 0083).
glossary.personality: Honorable, idealistic career soldier; charismatic leader who fights on the front line; hates the Federation but respects worthy opponents.

glossary.role: Commander of the Cima Fleet (ex-Zeon marines); allied with the Delaz Fleet, then betrays it to the Federation; pilots the Gelgoog Marine Commander Type and Gerbera Tetra. Rank: Lieutenant Colonel (中佐).
glossary.personality: Scheming, harsh and venomous, intolerant of failure, yet decisive and fiercely loyal to her own men; embittered by how Zeon used her and her homeland Mahal.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]デラーズ#cの<im(1)>コンペイトウ襲撃を防ぐことは
できなかった。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>We were unable to prevent #c[BE5050]Delaz#c's
<im(1)>assault on Konpei Island.
rows.notes: Sinapus reflecting on the nuclear strike aftermath.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(2)>だが、私はこれが終わりだとは
思っていない。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(2)>However, I do not believe this is
the end.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(7)>でなければ、#c[BE5050]デラーズ#cがあれだけの
<im(9)>演説をした理由が見当たらん。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(7)>Otherwise, there is no reason for
#c[BE5050]Delaz#c <im(9)>to have delivered such a speech.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(4)>まだ何か、これ以上に大がかりなことを
企んでいるからこそ、<im(8)>あれだけの大芝居を
打って見せたのだ。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(4)>He must be plotting something on an even
greater scale, <im(8)>which is why he put on
such an elaborate performance.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(10)>私はコーウェン准将に許可を取り、
#c[BE5050]デラーズ・フリート#cに対する
戦闘の続行を決定した。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(10)>I obtained permission from Commodore Cowen
and decided to continue operations
against the #c[BE5050]Delaz Fleet#c.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>これより本艦は<im(6)>ラビアンローズに向かい、
補給並びに戦力増強のため
#c[5E8FD8]ガンダム試作３号機#cを受け取る。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Our ship will now head to <im(6)>La Vie en Rose
to resupply and reinforce, receiving
#c[5E8FD8]Gundam GP03#c.
rows.notes: Albion en route to receive Gundam GP03.

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　Preventer Lady Une

<sp(0)><im(1)>#c[BE5050]ガンダム２号機#cによる核攻撃の被害は、

rows.en:
<sp(0)><im(1)>The nuclear strike by #c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2#c
destroyed two-thirds of the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c fleet.<im(3)>

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>その一方で、#c[BE5050]デラーズ・フリート#c指揮下の
#c[E2E258]シーマ・ガラハウ#c率いる部隊<im(4)>は、観艦式とは
まったく異なる方角へ向かっている。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Meanwhile, the #c[BE5050]Delaz Fleet#c forces led by
#c[E2E258]Cima Garahau#c<im(4)> are heading in a direction
completely different from the naval review.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>彼らが向かうサイド１付近に、大規模な
#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#cの拠点はないが、コロニー再生計画
のために２基のコロニーが移送されている。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>No large #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c base lies near Side 1 where
they head, but two colonies are moved
for the Colony Reclamation Project.
rows.notes: Colony Reclamation Project per 0083 lore. fix: linha com 433 px > 430 px e não cabe em 3 linhas -> balanced text across 3 lines under 430 px

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>観艦式での派手な行動とは対照的に、
隠密に徹したこの行動を見る限りでは、
観艦式テロ<im(2)>の方が陽動であった可能性もある。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Unlike the flashy attack at the review,
these strictly covert movements suggest
the review terror<im(2)> was a diversion.

rows.jp: <sp(0)>各部隊には、十分な警戒を求めたい。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>All units are urged to maintain
utmost vigilance.

<sp(0)>「バスターアークの動向」

rows.en:
<sp(0)>"Buster Ark Movements"

rows.jp:
<sp(0)><im(1)>先日、衛星軌道上で#c[BE5050]バスターアーク#cを
目撃した<im(2)>との報告が#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#c第二監視センター

rows.en:
<sp(0)><im(1)>Recently, a sighting of the #c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c
in satellite orbit <im(2)>was received from the
#c[5E8FD8]UCE#c Second Surveillance Center.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>同機は、これまでにも地上の各交戦地域で
目撃されてきたが、大気圏外での出現報告は
今回が初めてとなる。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>While previously sighted in various combat
zones on Earth, this is the first report
of its appearance outside the atmosphere.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>何らかの行動を起こす可能性が高いと
考えられるため、現在も#c[BE5050]バスターアーク#cの
監視行動を続行中である。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Since it is highly likely to take action,
surveillance of the #c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c
is currently ongoing.

report.translator_summary: Completed translation of op06_03 (25 rows), concluding Operation 06. Covers developer placeholder duel dialogue between Gato and the pilot/GP02 escape warnings, Captain Eyphar Sinapus's post-battle assessment on the Delaz Fleet and orders to rendezvous with La Vie en Rose for Gundam GP03, and Preventer intelligence reports by Lady Une on Cima Garahau's fleet movements toward Side 1 and the Buster Ark sighted in satellite orbit.

uncertainties.note: Commodore Cowen (コーウェン准将) retains rank 'Commodore' per glossary definition for 准将.
'コロニー再生計画' translated as 'Colony Reclamation Project' in accordance with official Gundam 0083 terminology.
